description: Puts a finished find_online lookup in front of the artist in Audora and returns the link to it. The artist confirms it is them and keeps what is right there. This call writes nothing to their profile, and you should not copy the findings into update_profile yourself. Their Home says their assistant found something to look at.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

run_id.description: The lookup to propose. Default: the newest.

name: propose_profile
title: Put what was found in front of the artist
